title: pteris dentata var. oligodyctyon
intro: Pteris dentata var. oligodyctyon, commonly known as the Hook Fern or Chain Fern, is a species of fern in the family Pteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asian countries, for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Pteris dentata var. oligodyctyon include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which help to reduce inflammation, prevent infections, and lower fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
